title: Tooling: 3.12× faster inplace-side prefix replay with identical receipts
body:
## Change and scope

At base `0b1cccf86e2f5132ed286a26ef0a681a495740ea`, the historical inplace-side prefix checker (`scripts/experiments/inplace_side.py:verify_prefix`) rejects a specified n-role Gauss–Jordan side family using three pinned witnesses (`h = 42, 46, 50`). Each elimination column previously rebuilt `sorted(unused)` to locate the least unused row with the pivot bit set.

This PR replaces that search with a least-unused flag scan and column masks. The lexicographic pivot rule, XOR updates, switch witnesses, deficit arithmetic and every receipt field are unchanged. Only the source pin for `scripts/experiments/inplace_side.py` changes inside `certificates/inplace-side.json`.

**Tooling improvement; no new kappa.** The selected frontier, `upstream/`, and the mathematical rejection in `docs/research/inplace-side.md` are not reopened.

## Result

On Linux / CPython 3.12.3, five alternating fresh-process pairs of the three pinned witnesses gave median **17.061 s → 5.466 s (3.12×)**. Timing is host-descriptive and is not a correctness gate. Receipts match the byte-identical baseline checker fieldwise; a greatest-unused mutant is rejected on all three witnesses.

Package: `research/inplace-side-performance/`.

## Validation

Python **3.12**, standard library only:

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/inplace-side-performance/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -B research/inplace-side-performance/verify.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/inplace-side-performance
python3.12 -I -B research/inplace-side-performance/benchmark.py --rounds 5
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_INPLACE_SIDE_PREFIX_FAST witnesses=3 h=[42, 46, 50] paths=[151, 415, 767] ... no_new_kappa
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/inplace-side-performance outcome=completed
PASS_IDENTICAL_INPLACE_PREFIX_RECEIPTS
```

Default verify is read-only. Use `--write-certificate` only after editing the production source. Full `make verify`, selected cold replay, Lean, and multiplication-theorem obligations were not rerun for this isolated historical-checker change.
